newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil industry employment falls 0.5 pct - IBGE.
newsitem.headline: Brazil industry employment falls 0.5 pct - IBGE.

text.p: Brazilian November industrial employment fell 0.5 percent from October and 7.6 percent compared with November 1995, the National Statistics Institute (IBGE) said.
Industrial employment fell 11.4 percent in the first eleven months of 1996 and 11.2 percent in the 12 months to November, the IBGE said in a statement.
The IBGE said November employment levels declined most in Sao Paulo state at one percent, while in the Northeast and South industrial employment increased 0.6 and 0.1 percent, respectively.
The largest employment losses were in the mechanical, rubber, paper, leather and textile sectors, the IBGE said.
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
